message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/h5_read_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":13,"var":"data[0] / decider","code":"uint8_t decider = data[0];","note":"The first attacker-controlled byte selects the HDF5 API path; the harness always takes the H5Fopen branch because decider % 1 == 0."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/h5_read_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"data[1..size-1]","code":"fwrite(data, size, 1, fp);","note":"The remaining attacker-controlled bytes are written verbatim to a temporary file that becomes the HDF5 input."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/h5_read_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":21,"var":"filename","code":"H5Fopen(filename, H5F_ACC_RDONLY, H5P_DEFAULT);","note":"The harness opens the attacker-crafted file through the HDF5 library, handing parsing control to the file reader."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/H5F.c","function":"H5Fopen","line":826,"var":"filename","code":"if ((ret_value = H5F__open_api_common(filename, flags, fapl_id, NULL)) < 0)","note":"H5Fopen forwards the filename into the internal open path, which parses the file structure and discovers datasets and datatypes."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/H5D.c","function":"H5Dread","line":1058,"var":"buf","code":"H5D__read_api_common(1, &dset_id, &mem_type_id, &mem_space_id, &file_space_id, dxpl_id, &buf, NULL, NULL)","note":"The vulnerable target's read path eventually reaches dataset I/O, where the caller-supplied buffer is the destination for file data."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/H5D.c","function":"H5D__read_api_common","line":946,"var":"count / dset_id[0] / buf","code":"H5VL_dataset_read_direct(count, obj, connector, mem_type_id, mem_space_id, file_space_id, dxpl_id, buf, token_ptr)","note":"The dataset read helper resolves the dataset object and dispatches the actual read to the VOL layer."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/H5Dchunk.c","function":"H5D__chunk_direct_read","line":493,"var":"buf","code":"H5F_shared_block_read(H5F_SHARED(dset->oloc.file), H5FD_MEM_DRAW, udata.chunk_block.offset, udata.chunk_block.length, buf)","note":"The raw chunk reader copies chunk bytes from the file into the destination buffer; if the chunk metadata is inconsistent with the buffer size, this becomes the heap-buffer-overflow read sink."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/h5_read_fuzzer.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json
